input.body:
Dear Harper,

Thank you for your reply about the sticking front door at Flat 16, 76 Alder Lane, Kingshaven ZZ8 8ZZ (ref R/PM015-1).

We're happy to ask Imogen to take a look, but we don't have her details on our records. Could you please send us Imogen's full name or business name and a phone number or email address, so we can contact her and put her in touch with the tenant to arrange access?

If it helps us, please also let us know whether Imogen will invoice you directly or through us.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
